scope.flow: batchTransfers and rBatchTransfers token movement while the contract is paused
scope.environment: WERC7575ShareToken contract with a pause mechanism and whenNotPaused-guarded transfer/transferFrom

statements.text: The contract owner has explicitly paused the token.
The contract exposes batchTransfers and rBatchTransfers functions for bulk token movements.
The standard transfer and transferFrom functions include the whenNotPaused modifier and revert when the contract is paused.
Call batchTransfers or rBatchTransfers while the contract is paused.
batchTransfers and rBatchTransfers omit the whenNotPaused modifier, so they remain operational regardless of the paused state.
Bulk token movements continue even though the contract owner has paused the token.
A compromised or malicious validator can move tokens between arbitrary addresses during the pause, potentially extracting funds while administrators believe transfers are halted.
While the contract is paused, all token movement, including batch transfers, must cease until the pause is resolved.
The scenario assumes the owner has engaged the pause before the batch transfer call.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the validator is authorized to call batchTransfers or whether anyone can call it.
No concrete transaction or observed incident is provided; the bypass is described as a capability.
The rBatchTransfers function's exact behavior is not detailed beyond omitting the modifier.
